# Intake: Split gate and concurrency tests

**Work Item:** Child of WL-0MV28X3SL005R5KX
**Issue Type:** task
**Priority:** medium
**Dependencies:** WL-0MV4V0V8Z003PBQ2 (shared fixture module)

## Problem statement

Extract all gate, concurrency, and transient retry tests from `downtime-worker.test.ts` into `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.gates.test.ts`.

## Describe blocks to extract

1. `pipeline single-flight — one in-flight dispatch pipeline at a time` (line 8428)
2. `idle gate — no dispatch with zero free slots` (line 8454)
3. `idle gate — no dispatch with zero free slots (fast-mode operator priority)` (line 8475)
4. `bounded concurrent dispatch — claim safety regression` (line 8491)
5. `isTransientDowntimeError` (nested under needsProducerReview, line 7778)
6. `withTransientRetry` (nested under needsProducerReview, line 7810)

Note: The transient retry tests are nested under `needsProducerReview exclusion` but test the `isTransientDowntimeError` and `withTransientRetry` utilities. They may be more logically placed here.

2. Each extracted test retains its original assertions (no regression).
3. The split file is ≤ 2,000 lines.
4. The split file imports `makeDeps` from the shared fixture module.
5. All tests pass after the split.

- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` — Source

# Cooldown regression guard and full-suite verification

**Parent:** WL-0MV54ZP3Y00514Y9 (Resume model-exhausted jobs instead of switching to cheap)

## Goal

Prove the withdrawn client-side drain has not been reintroduced and that the
whole project suite passes with the cooldown changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC6 — Tests: unit + integration tests cover detection, gating, wake, cross-root and failure paths.
- [ ] AC8 — Full-suite: the full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
- [ ] Regression guard: a regression test proves the withdrawn client drain is not reintroduced.
- [ ] Baseline: the suite test count and runtime before and after are recorded in a work-item comment.

## Verification detail

Elaborates the ACs above (planning tooling extracts only the first line of each
bullet).

- AC6 (parent AC6 "Tests"): the covered paths are detection (exhaustion
  classification), gating (cheap-switch hold), wake (bounded resume),
  cross-root (two-root integration) and the failure paths (unreadable signal,
  unwritable marker, absent Retry-After).
- AC8 (parent AC8 "Full-suite"): run the project suite command from the
  repository root and require a clean pass.
- Regression guard specifics: assert there is no client-side slot-count
  completion gate, no dispatch pause and no unbounded latch in the new paths —
  the three things the withdrawn predecessor
  (`WL-0MUWIHUL2000JEFR`) removed.
- Baseline: record the pre-change and post-change totals so suite drift is
  visible.

## Deliverables

- The regression test proving the withdrawn drain is not reintroduced.
- A recorded full-suite run (count and runtime before/after).
- The baseline comment on the parent work item.

**Key Files:**
- `packages/herdr/src/mode-switch-worker.test.ts`
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.dispatch.test.ts`
- `packages/tui/extensions/Worklog/lib/recovery/retry-loop.test.ts`
- `docs/dev/test-suite-baseline.md`

## Dependencies

Depends on `Recovery loop records durable cooldown`, `Cheap-switch gate honours
model cooldowns`, `Bounded wake of one cooled-down job` and `Bounded default
cooldown and fail-closed hardening`.

data.description:
Discovered during WL-0MV4VQ78L003TGY6 (discovered-from:WL-0MV4VQ78L003TGY6).

## Problem
`implement.py finish`'s test gate failed twice with a spurious 'live-repo mutation detected' verdict even though the canonical suite passed (both declared commands exited 0). The guard (`skill/shared/git_sandbox.py` `snapshot_repo_state`/`diff_snapshots`, used by `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py:guarded_run_all`) snapshots refs, local `.git/config`, registered worktrees, and `git status` before/after the suite. On a multi-agent host with several active worktrees, concurrent agent activity moved:
- `refs/remotes/origin/dev` (observed bbc8e89a -> 4163175)
- `refs/heads/dev` (main checkout's local dev, advanced by another agent's finish fast-forward)
- another agent's feature branch ref

Only refs checked out in agent worktrees under `.worklog/worktrees/` (and their `branch.<name>.*` config) are excluded, so these deltas fail the gate.

## Impact
`implement.py finish` fails after a ~17-minute suite run and resets the item to `open`; the agent must sync its worktree to the latest `dev` and re-warm the test cache before retrying. Observed twice on WL-0MV4VQ78L003TGY6.

## Possible fix
Exclude `refs/heads/dev`, `refs/remotes/origin/dev` and `refs/remotes/origin/*` (or ignore ref movement entirely) from the mutation diff while still catching working-tree mutations caused by the suite itself; or scope the ref check to refs the suite could plausibly touch.

## Workaround
Fast-forward the worktree to the latest `origin/dev`, run the full suite once to warm the per-command cache, then re-run `implement.py finish` (cache hits shrink the race window).
data.title: Finish-gate live-repo guard trips on concurrent dev ref movement in multi-agent repos
